attestations.text: HUANG P'ei-lieh 黃丕烈 (T. 紹武, H. 蕘圃, 復翁, 秋清居士, 佞宋主人, and more than twenty other hao), June 21, 1763–1825, Sept., bibliophile, was a native of Ch'ang-chou (Soochow). He was a chü-jên of 1788.
